description: For closed arithmetic axioms \(T\), a finite additional context \(\Gamma\) and conclusion \(A\) over original names \(X\), a raw certificate carries a finite support \(\Delta\subseteq T_X\cup\Gamma\) and an actual raw deduction tree of \(\Delta\Rightarrow A\) over \(X\), with no auxiliary reserve. Logical equality is enabled, and either deduction mode is allowed.
